skills.name: Common denominator
skills.definition: Find equivalent fractions with a common denominator when the fractions being subtracted have different denominators.

skills.name: Fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of two fractions that already share the same denominator.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: Regroup one whole unit into a fraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than that of the subtrahend.

skills.name: Mixed number operations
skills.definition: Correctly handle numbers composed of a whole-number part and a fractional part during subtraction.

skills.name: Improper fraction handling
skills.definition: Interpret and operate on a fractional part whose numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator within a mixed number.

skills.name: Whole-fraction interaction
skills.definition: Perform subtraction between a whole number and a fraction or mixed number.
